target_candidates.name: dated_observed_flood_event
target_candidates.definition: A flood, flash flood, riverine flood, coastal flood, or flood-associated landslide that a named authority recorded at a place with a calendar date.
target_candidates.spatial_grain: community / named settlement, falling back to district only if flagged
target_candidates.lead_time: hours–days before event_start using past-only rainfall windows
target_candidates.required_data: NDMA register or equivalent dated assessment; location at least district
target_candidates.limitations: Register access required; under-reporting of minor events; delayed assessments

target_candidates.name: geographic_inundation_event
target_candidates.definition: Satellite-mapped surface water beyond permanent water over a known interval.
target_candidates.spatial_grain: raster (e.g. 250 m MODIS GFD) or Copernicus EMS polygons
target_candidates.lead_time: poor for Freetown flash floods; better for prolonged riverine water
target_candidates.limitations: Misses many urban flash floods; 2017 Freetown event was mudflow/landslide mapping
target_candidates.role: independent spatial corroboration, not the primary CHEWS target

target_candidates.name: community_level_flood_occurrence
target_candidates.definition: Same as A, restricted to a named community matching flood_zones or NDMA place names.
target_candidates.required_data: community names in the source, not synthetic CHW CSV
target_candidates.limitations: Name matching is uncertain; 23 CHEWS zones do not cover all NDMA places
target_candidates.role: preferred grain of target A when the source names a community

target_candidates.name: facility_accessibility_disruption
target_candidates.definition: A health facility unreachable or damaged because of flood.
target_candidates.lead_time: operational overlay after an event is known
target_candidates.required_data: dated facility closure/damage records joined to MFL coordinates
target_candidates.limitations: No such outcomes exist in CHEWS today
target_candidates.role: future health-connection layer, not the first target

target_candidates.name: district_level_flood_occurrence
target_candidates.definition: At least one documented flood in a district on a date.
target_candidates.lead_time: weaker: centroid weather, mixed event types
target_candidates.limitations: Hides intra-district differences; centroid weather is a high-uncertainty fallback

target_candidates.name: flood_severity_category
target_candidates.definition: Ordinal impact class (e.g. NDMA/IFRC assessment grade).
target_candidates.required_data: source-provided grade; otherwise estimated and labelled as such
target_candidates.limitations: CHEWS must not invent severity from rainfall
target_candidates.role: optional observed field if the source grades the event

recommended_target.name: dated_observed_flood_event_at_community_grain
recommended_target.fallback: E district-day if community unknown, with mapping_uncertainty=high

canonical_schema.name: chews_flood_event_v0
canonical_schema.grain: one row = one dated flood at one place
canonical_schema.weather_join: separate past-only extract keyed by event_id after acquisition

weather_alignment.windows: t-1, t-3, t-7 ending the day before event_start; t0 contemporaneous only
variables: later: percentile/anomaly vs past-only expanding wet-season distribution at the same point

A_statistical_rule_backtesting.purpose: Estimate miss rate, false-alarm rate, and lead time of a disclosed rainfall/zone rule.

minimum.districts_or_distinct_regimes: ≥8 districts, or Western Area plus ≥4 inland/coastal districts so Freetown flash flood is not the only regime
minimum.event_types: at least flash vs riverine/coastal if claiming a national rule
minimum.non_event_rule: Silent days are negatives ONLY if the same source would have recorded an event. Missing register coverage is not a non-flood label.

A_statistical_rule_backtesting.why: Three wet seasons prevent fitting a rule to one unusual year. About 30 dated events is the smallest count where a miss rate is even interpretable (e.g. 5 misses in 30 is 17%, with a still-wide confidence interval). Fewer than ~15 day-dated events cannot tell a useless rule from noise. Geographic diversity is required because coastal Bonthe, inland rivers, and Freetown informal settlements are different processes.

B_controlled_shadow_validation.purpose: Observe a frozen rainfall/zone rule on refreshed weather without live CHEWS alerts.

minimum.weather: daily precip at event/zone coordinates covering those seasons (past-only)
minimum.corroboration: subset of events also in IFRC DREF / ReliefWeb or equivalent
minimum.isolation: no dashboard, risk engine, or notifications

B_controlled_shadow_validation.why: Malaria shadow was possible because DHIS2 positivity already existed. Flood shadow requires the event list first; weather without events is not a flood shadow.

C_supervised_ml.purpose: Only if a rule baseline is already backtested and remaining error is not a simple rain cut.

minimum.includes: A and B completed, with a published rule baseline
minimum.must_beat: lead time and missed-event rate of the rule, not accuracy

C_supervised_ml.why: Flood days are rare. A classifier rewarded for accuracy will predict non-flood. Five seasons and ~100 events still may not justify ML; they are a floor for even asking the question. Default remains the simpler rule if ML does not win on lead time and misses.

candidates_to_evaluate_later: t-1 / t-3 / t-7 precipitation sum vs that location's expanding wet-season percentile
rolling accumulation ending at t-1 (not t0) in mapped flood zones
event recurrence calendar (same community, same calendar month in prior years) as context only
must_not: fit a mm cut on the same events then call it validation
treat missing register days as non-flood without a coverage statement
first_defensible_baseline_once_events_ex.ml_rule: An ML model is only justified if it beats this baseline on lead time and missed-event rate.

required_to_become_useful.location: GPS or verified community id matching MFL/COD/flood zone
required_to_become_useful.timestamp: ISO datetime, timezone Africa/Abidjan; report time vs event time distinguished
required_to_become_useful.reporter: stable CHW/NDMA officer id; role; organisation
required_to_become_useful.verification: second source or supervisor flag; unverified reports stay unverified
required_to_become_useful.duplicates: space-time clustering (same community, same 24h) before counting events
required_to_become_useful.confidence: explicit low/medium/high; never implied by damaged_houses
required_to_become_useful.spatial_accuracy: record GPS error or admin-level if GPS absent
required_to_become_useful.impact_fields: optional observed impact; must not be model features if they define the label

roles_if_quality_met.event_detection: possible near-real-time signal, still not the historical target
roles_if_quality_met.independent_validation: only if independent of the NDMA row being validated
roles_if_quality_met.confirmation: yes, with timestamps after the event

would_warn_about: likely flooding at a known exposed community or zone
possible disruption of access to listed nearby health facilities
community exposure (population in catalog / MFL catchment)
would_not_claim: disease outbreak caused by the flood
warning_contents: expected timing (nowcast vs t-1/t-3 rainfall context — not a false NWP strip)
evidence (which source would confirm; rainfall window used)
affected facilities/communities if a spatial join is valid
recommended verification (NDMA / DHMT / CHW), not automatic public-health action
